text: The river had been rising for two days before anyone thought to worry about it, and by the third it had swallowed the {0} where the cattle usually grazed. Halloran stood at the edge of his land watching brown water move {1} across ground that had never once, in his memory, been anything but dry. He'd moved the animals up to higher pasture the night before, more out of {2} than certainty, and was glad of it now, watching fence posts disappear one by one beneath the surface. Neighbours further down the valley had it worse, their fields turned to a single {3} sheet of water that reflected the sky like something out of a different, stranger world. It would take a week for the water to properly recede, and rather longer than that for the memory of it to {4}, but for now everyone simply stood at their fences, watching the river do as it pleased.
